CA.rationale: Content (red positions) is explicitly paired with an origin/processing condition for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: The content (red positions), a presentation/organization statement (grid orientation), and an explicit origin/status are all provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Origin/processing kinds (history_estimate, command_estimate) are explicitly attached to specific content referents, linking processing/source to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with attributes (red/blue coordinates) are listed for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are provided separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The text describes how coordinates map to rows/columns and lists organized position sets for contents.
